purpose: Runtime-safe complete-training rank-ladder jobs for the active autotuned source candidate

priority_first_gate.purpose: Bounded first gate for the explicitly requested key ranks
priority_first_gate.shared_input_rule: One changed input hash per sample across all five selected kernel ranks and the native FLA anchor in each mode/hardware job
priority_first_gate.edge_scope: Adjacent in this priority rank order only; this gate does not replace the requested ladder edge split jobs

job_matrix.definition: Priority first gate followed by the Cartesian product of modes, hardware_order, and split_groups
job_matrix.hardware_sequence: Run priority first-gate Full then Block jobs on H100!, then the six ladder split groups in order; repeat the same sequence on B200
job_matrix.effective_config: Load the mode base_config and replace only ranks with either priority_first_gate.ranks or the selected split group's ranks
job_matrix.timed_kernel_arms: one kernel arm per selected rank
job_matrix.timed_fla_arm: one native Triton checkpoint-1 standard R=D arm per job
job_matrix.shared_input_rule: All kernel and FLA arms in one job receive one changed input hash per sample
job_matrix.cross_job_rule: Do not join raw samples, ratios, bootstrap pools, or hardware arms across jobs

every_job: reference qualification passed for every kernel rank
compile and complete-step CUDA Graph capture passed for every timed arm
120 rows per timed arm with finite positive latency
changed inputs and one shared input hash per sample
zero timed graph breaks, recompiles, or new unique graphs
audit_requirements.priority_first_gate: Require the same complete-training, qualification, capture, changed-input, and graph-stability checks for all four priority jobs; evaluate only the four adjacent pairs in priority_first_gate.adjacent_rank_order_pairs
audit_requirements.edge_gate: Evaluate each listed adjacent edge only within the split job containing both ranks; report cross-job familywise status as unavailable
audit_requirements.hardware_gate: H100! and B200 are independent replications, never paired observations
